types.name: Subject
types.description: A claim subject: the person, organization, user, or agent that a claim is about.

types.name: Person
types.description: A human subject represented in the claim graph.

types.name: Corporation
types.description: An organizational subject represented in the claim graph.

types.name: User
types.description: A person operating a Mee identity agent or local-first assistant.

types.name: IdentityAgent
types.description: A local identity agent that stores, syncs, and reasons over claim data.

types.name: PaymentCard
types.description: A payment card credential carrying card network, card number, CVV, and expiration details.

types.name: DriverLicense
types.description: A driving-privilege record: which state issued the license, the license number, and which driving categories/endorsements (e.g. motorcycle, commercial) it authorizes. Carries no personal identity fields (no name, date of birth, address, or photo) -- use `DriversLicenseDocument` for the identity claims printed on the physical license.

types.name: DrivingCategory
types.description: A licensed driving class or endorsement code with a human-readable description. Nested only under `DriverLicense.driving_category` -- never a standalone/root entity.

types.name: BirthCertificateDocument
types.description: An identity document record carrying birth-certificate name claims.

types.name: DriversLicenseDocument
types.description: The identity document record carrying the claims printed on a government-issued driver's license: legal name, date of birth, license number, expiration date, residential address, issuing jurisdiction, and photo. Carries no driving categories/endorsements -- use `DriverLicense` for those.

types.name: PassportDocument
types.description: An identity document record carrying passport claims such as legal name, passport number, issue and expiration dates, issuing country, place of birth, and gender marker.

types.name: MedicalAppointmentRecord
types.description: A shareable medical-appointment record containing the claims needed to coordinate care for a patient, including patient reference, insurance, medications, allergies, and care contacts.

types.name: CheckingAccount
types.description: A bank checking account record with account and routing identifiers.

types.name: Wallet
types.description: A physical wallet record that can contain physical cards and other personal documents.

types.name: PhysicalCard
types.description: A physical card carried in a wallet, such as a driver's license, health insurance card, or payment card.

types.name: PetMedicationRecord
types.description: A shareable record of a pet's medications, each with dosage and administration details.

types.name: Medication
types.description: A single medication entry within a pet medication record, including active ingredients, dose form, dosage, and administration schedule.

types.name: DosageAmount
types.description: A structured dosage amount consisting of a decimal value and a unit of measure.

types.name: MedicationAdministration
types.description: The administration schedule for a medication, including frequency and start/end dates.

types.name: ContactInfo
types.description: A JSContact-style contact card carrying name, organization, and contact-channel claims for a subject.

types.name: Anniversary
types.description: A dated anniversary entry, such as a wedding date or a custom recurring date, attached to a contact card.

types.name: legal-given-name
types.description: A person's legal given or first name.

types.name: legal-family-name
types.description: A person's legal family or last name.

types.name: email-address
types.description: An electronic mail address recorded as a claim value.

types.name: phone-number
types.description: A telephone number recorded as a claim value.

types.name: home-address
types.description: A residential or home address recorded as a claim value.

types.name: date-of-birth
types.description: A person's birth date.

types.name: age-over-18
types.description: A boolean claim indicating whether a subject is at least eighteen years old.

types.name: account-id
types.description: An account identifier used by an external service or relying party.

types.name: group-name
types.description: The name of a group, club, or affiliation.

types.name: payment-card-last4
types.description: The final four digits of a payment card number.

types.name: seating-preference
types.description: A person's seating preference for travel or events.

types.name: meal-preference
types.description: A person's meal preference for travel, events, or hospitality.

types.name: safety-word
types.description: A shared safety word or phrase recorded as a claim value.

types.name: primary-physician
types.description: A primary-care physician recorded as a claim value.

types.name: vaccination-status
types.description: A free-text vaccination status or summary.

types.name: allergy
types.description: An allergy recorded as a single free-text string; repeat for multiple allergies.

types.name: driver-license-status
types.description: A driver-license status claim.

types.name: membership-status
types.description: A membership or affiliation status claim.

types.name: employment-title
types.description: A job or employment title claim.

types.name: organization-affiliation
types.description: An organization with which a subject is affiliated.

types.name: social-security-number
types.description: A United States Social Security number claim.

types.name: passport-number
types.description: A passport number identifying a government-issued passport.

types.name: issuing-country
types.description: The country that issued a government document such as a passport.

types.name: place-of-birth
types.description: The place where a person was born as recorded on an identity document.

types.name: gender-marker
types.description: The gender marker shown on a government-issued identity document.

types.name: issue-date
types.description: The date on which a government document was issued.

types.name: drivers-license-number
types.description: The license number printed on a driver's license document.

types.name: issuing-jurisdiction
types.description: The jurisdiction that issued a state or regional identity document.

types.name: credential
types.description: A credential or authorization claim value.

types.name: organization-unit
types.description: A department, team, or organizational unit claim.

types.name: job-title
types.description: A professional job title claim.

types.name: personal-info-kind
types.description: A label identifying the kind of personal information being recorded.

types.name: personal-info-value
types.description: The value of a generic personal-information claim.

types.name: personal-info-level
types.description: A level or sensitivity classification for generic personal information.

types.name: current-medication
types.description: A medication the patient is currently taking, represented as free text.

types.name: medical-history-note
types.description: A free-text summary of relevant medical history or ongoing conditions.

types.name: insurance-provider
types.description: The health insurance provider associated with a medical appointment record.

types.name: insurance-policy-number
types.description: The health insurance policy number associated with a medical appointment record.

types.name: insurance-group-number
types.description: The health insurance group number associated with a medical appointment record.

types.name: preferred-pharmacy
types.description: The patient's preferred pharmacy.

types.name: physical-card-scan
types.description: A URI or reference to an image scan of a physical card.

types.name: wallet-label
types.description: A human-readable label for a wallet.

types.name: health-insurance-card-id
types.description: An identifier printed on a physical health insurance card.

types.name: medication-start-date

types.name: medication-end-date
types.description: Ontology type for medication end date; source reference pets:MedicationAdministration.

types.name: network

types.name: cvv

types.name: expiry-month

types.name: expiry-year

types.name: license-number

types.name: issuing-state

types.name: driving-category-code

types.name: driving-category-description

types.name: additional-name

types.name: expiration-date

types.name: photo-uri

types.name: routing-number

types.name: physical-card-kind
